message: 密会
It was quiet.
No, it wasn't merely quiet.
The treetops didn't stir in the slightest; not even the faintest breeze was blowing.

name: Soltia
message: 「As always, you disguise yourself remarkably well」

name: Soltia
message: 「I had thought angels were inherently divine by their very nature, though」

name: Azel
message: 「You're quite skilled at imitating humans yourself」

name: Azel
message: 「Being equally lowly, perhaps it's easy for you to blend in」

name: Virus
message: 「Why don't you leave it at that」

name: Virus
message: 「Even though we've temporarily joined forces, we're hardly on friendly terms. Before we start rubbing each other the wrong way, the smart move would be to get this over with quickly」

name: Azel
message: 「...Agreed」

name: Virus
message: 「Seeing you in those forms means placing the magic circles in the urban district is finished, then」

name: Soltia
message: 「Yes. Out of the seventy-seven planned magic circles, all forty-four in the urban district have been set up」

name: Azel
message: 「I've confirmed it」

name: Virus
message: 「And the rest?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Pasta and I will infiltrate the academy and handle the work there」

name: Virus
message: 「What's the likelihood of interference?」
The young man prompted the two of them.

name: Azel
message: 「...There is no movement from Heaven」

name: Virus
message: 「They don't have the nerve to start a conflict anyway」

name: Azel
message: 「...If that weren't the case, I would never ally myself with the likes of you, even temporarily」

name: Soltia
message: 「Among the Seven Demon Generals, those who have not sided with us--Eauderourke and Melphas--have been confirmed active in the Human World」

name: Azel
message: 「Those who cannot even defeat lowly humans are of no consequence」

name: Soltia
message: 「Ardin will probably show up before long, won't he?」

name: Virus
message: 「We can handle him either way. If he challenges us, it'll be a bit of fun, and if we can use him, we will」

name: Virus
message: 「Out of the three, Melphas is the only one we need to be wary of. Though I did invite him」

name: Soltia
message: 「Him, challenging us?　That's impossible」

name: Virus
message: 「He is a whimsical one, after all」

name: Azel
message: 「I met him at the academy」

name: Virus
message: 「Oh?」

name: Azel
message: 「Just like you lot, he's beneath notice」

name: Virus
message: 「To you, perhaps」

name: Virus
message: 「However, to the ones carrying out the work, he is a threat」

name: Soltia
message: 「My, how awfully kind of you」

name: Virus
message: 「Even with a margin factored in, our time is limited」

name: Azel
message: 「And the other one?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Unconfirmed. Neither in the Human World nor the Demon World」

name: Virus
message: 「They won't make a move anyway. All they ever do is observe and record」

name: Virus
message: 「Still, if the opportunity arises, I would like to cross blades with the Witch at least once」

name: Virus
message: 「What of the Student Council?　You made contact, didn't you?」

name: Azel
message: 「No issues」

name: Soltia
message: 「I did warn Pasta to be careful. That should be enough」

name: Virus
message: 「Hmm... For now, that will do」

name: Soltia
message: 「There are no signs that the Demon Lord you're so concerned about has appeared」

name: Azel
message: 「Merely a legend」

name: Virus
message: 「No. The Demon Lord is real」

name: Virus
message: 「When Re-Crea reaches criticality, the Demon King will inevitably appear.」
Virus smiled, looking somewhat pleased.
